items.prompt: Create ONE square game creature-card illustration of MIGAO FEN, an original stuffed TEDDY BEAR. The supplied human shield-warrior image is a PAINTING-STYLE reference ONLY: borrow its deliberate hand-painted anime color planes, light/shadow grouping, selective contours and muted chromatic palette. Do not copy the human, face, shield, armor, scarf or pose. Subject is a single recognizable plush teddy bear, soft rounded ears, warm honey-brown short-pile cloth, dark sewn button eyes with modest highlights, small embroidered dark triangular nose and stitched mouth, round padded belly, visible but restrained sewn seams, one slightly darker cloth patch on an ear and one small repaired patch on the belly. Short mitten-like plush paws, rounded plush feet, no human fingers, no fur-realistic animal anatomy. Give the toy a quiet determined protective presence and appealing original silhouette: sturdy three-quarter standing stance, one padded paw raised slightly forward and the other relaxed, slight head tilt, seen from a modest low angle. The bear fills about 80 percent of the square, complete ears and both feet inside frame; enlarge head and upper body enough to read in a small card thumbnail. Strong warm cream side light, cool muted blue-gray cast shadows, a few broad directional strokes that describe plush volume, face and stitch attachment points clear; cloth surfaces mostly quiet with a little felt texture locally, no fuzzy noise filter or patchwork of tiny paint chips. Background a simple abstract smoky slate-teal field with one broad warm ochre brush mass behind its silhouette, a faint ground contact shadow, no detailed environment. Large matte opaque masses and firm, selectively softened turning edges, controlled handmade lines, tactile fabric and solid volume. Cute but composed, not a plastic 3D mascot, not flat vector clipart. No weapons, gas mask, military uniform, armor, human characters, writing, frame, logo or watermark. Final square card art only.
